title: Aligning Large Language Models from Self-Reference AI Feedback with one General Principle
reasoning: The paper benchmarks the alignment of LLMs using datasets such as PKU-SafeRLHF and HH-RLHF (Harmlessness), which are designed to evaluate and improve the ethical and moral behavior of models. The core of the research involves training the model on a 'best for humanity' principle to ensure it adheres to societal values and avoids harmful outputs like discrimination or hate speech.
